notes.title: JULY UPDATE IS OUT
notes.content:
[h1]The July Update is EVERYWHERE[/h1]
You can't escape it now! It's HERE. It's NOW. And it's HERE NOW. ːauripː ːauyayː

(Btw, I put $5 into my Steam account and got a bunch of emojis. ːsunglassesDogeː I feel like I'm finally catching up with you kids. ːVSnakeː)

[h2]ːawyeaː Features ːawyeaː[/h2]
[list]
[*] ːMillerː [b]Button Graphics[/b]: Each achievement unlocks Unlocks now (that's their official name). Your button could be a drum, or a goose, or a gun! Each can also be recolored too, just like the regular button, for an effect that's just so YOU!!!! We currently have 11 unlocks but will add more in the future... ːReeneOKː
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031805/852283c1723d3c84c8ec3c090803eff3a16d3436.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031805/66bab20f7095b37d64d5011541605fa41f662c68.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031805/bf11fa11b905cd4f705369929887227a325a201e.jpg[/img]
[*] ːshadeknightː [b]Dark mode[/b]: You didn't ask for it, but you got it! Experience BUTTON with a soothing background and less eye strain.

I know you could already see it in the previous pics, but I didn't want to re-take them in light mode... ːReeneangryː so here you go!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031805/e1b4566fcc7b2dcb509f2fb6c8328c557d1c3e36.jpg[/img]
[*] ːp2wheatleyː [b]More Developer Commentary![/b] 2 more hours of developer commentary, that you can get clicking up to 748 now! [b]NOTE: You'll have to reset your data and click back up to 217 to start hearing the new commentary. (I might make this easier in a future update)[/b]
[/list]

[h2]ːfluffystore_puff2ː Quality of Life ːfluffystore_puff2ː[/h2]
[list]
[*] ːIFHotDogː Game now autoloads on start
[*] ːsadistpoliteː Commentary volume and button color now save when you Save and Quit
[*] ːperretː The menu buttons have been reorganized. This doesn't actually make anything better, it was just easier to program this way.
[/list]

I didn't think BUTTON could get any better. I've proven myself wrong. Which means I was right all along. ːvanilla2ː

Enjoy the update. You can get it now. SO DO!!!! ːpfffː

Euphorically yours, ːGiftedː
Josh Powlison ːburgersandwichː
Creator of [i]Josh Powlison's BUTTON: Mildly Remastered Edition[/i] ːshelterfrogː

notes.title: July Update Is Almost Here
notes.content:
I'm testing it on Steam today, but it has so much more than you could've imagined:
[list]
[*] An additional 2 hours of developer commentary (you have commentary past click 700 now)
[*] Graphic skins and sounds you can unlock (they're tied to achievements, so you might already have them all!)
[*] DARK MODE!!!!! (nobody asked for it, but I know you were all thinking it)
[*] A lot of code updates that don't improve performance for you, but they certainly improve it for me
[/list]
I probably forgot multiple things that I'll have to post about later.
I'll probably have to do a video about it.
I don't know what I'll do.

But whatever I do, we together will experience...






...euphoria.

Updatically yours,
Josh Powlison
Creator of [i]Josh Powlison's BUTTON: Mildly Remastered Edition[/i]
